checkpoint_inference.scope: Frozen checkpoint loading and CPU synthetic output consistency; not dataset metric reevaluation.

result_value_parity.scope: Saved result CSV values unchanged; publication names and paths only

original_source_integrity.scope: Original paper2 files referenced by initial source/evidence/checkpoint manifests; not an all-files pre/post snapshot. Read-only SHA-256 comparison.

zip_restore.output_root: temporary verification directory, removed after complete hash verification
zip_restore.scope: All renamed ZIP assets and aliases restored to a separate temporary directory; original checkpoint tree not modified.

local_document_links.scope: Local Markdown links in root, docs and environment; external network links not revalidated.

limitations: No dataset payloads or frozen per-origin arrays are supplied; obtain official data and follow the documented reconstruction scope.
Legacy external Exact/SCPRC checkpoints excluded by requested scope; the corresponding external rows are summary/provenance evidence, not a complete frozen-inference release.
R10 fixed-distance graph baseline is not included among accepted main weights; adaptive GWN/MTGNN are not claimed.
CPU synthetic acceptance passed; CUDA forward parity and real-data metric recomputation were not performed in this migration.
PhaseFormer license text is absent from the pinned local snapshot and DLinear reference license text remains unverified; resolve public redistribution terms before publishing.
Original native checkpoint bytes retain embedded optimizer/PRNG states where present, to preserve trusted original hashes; no separate optimizer cache tree is copied.

checkpoint_inference.scope: synthetic fixed inputs and original/migrated weight parity, not reevaluation of dataset metrics

metadata.gate_flags: Checkpoint gate_flags override public metadata; independent/strict named-arm source constructors independently validate forward parity.

local_document_links.scope: root user-facing docs and docs/ local links; upstream network links not revalidated

record_scope: Local preparation snapshot before GitHub upload. remote_published, git_remote_configured and git_committed describe that preparation stage; the remote repository, commit history and Releases are authoritative for publication status.
